overview: Once Human's base map, Nalcott, is covered by the Manibus scenario (aka Evolution's Call) — not a single region itself, but an umbrella containing 6 regions, each centered on one Stronghold/settlement and gated by a recommended enemy level. Later seasons add separate Visional Worlds / Strange Worlds layered on top of this base map.

regions.biome: Fishing town, industrial area, flooded/unstable terrain
regions.notes: Home to the Gaia Cliff Monolith and the Treant boss.

regions.notes: Home to the Mirage Monolith and the Arachsiam boss.

correctionNote: An earlier version of this file wrongly nested Meyer's Market, Tall Grass Inn and Blackfell as flat 'areas' under one combined Manibus region, while separately listing Broken Delta, Iron River, Chalk Peak and Red Sands as unrelated 'other areas' — without noticing those are the actual regions those same strongholds belong to. Fixed by pairing each region with its real stronghold, sourced against the Once Human Fandom wiki and community area guides.
